assessment.reportedCompletion: 80%; numerator, denominator, scope and observation date unverified
assessment.basis: L1 is not demonstrated: no direct clean-bootstrap evidence. Levels are cumulative, not averaged or inferred from completion.
assessment.proposedTarget: L4, only if confirmed as appropriate for intended delegation

work_definition.limit: 80% proves neither bounded tasks nor acceptance criteria.

repository_knowledge.limit: Existing tracking alone does not demonstrate current architecture, ownership or truthful status.

verification_loop.limit: Reported flaky CI; commands, critical runtime coverage and flake control remain unverified. Blocks L3.

machine_usable_tooling.limit: No demonstrated structured tools, scoped access or fallbacks.

security_boundaries.limit: Sandbox undocumented; enforcement and environment separation unverified. Blocks L4.

small_batch_reviewability.limit: Rollback undocumented and unproven; independent review unverified. Blocks L4.

observability_runtime_verification.limit: No deployment identity, health or runtime evidence supplied.

evaluation_governance.limit: No held-out results, real-task metrics, thresholds or active delegation policy supplied.

authority.rule: Apply the narrowest boundary from current readiness, task risk, operational health and actual policy. Existing explicit bounded remediation authorization remains valid.
authority.R0: Explore and propose; no new write or delivery authority inferred.
authority.R1: Explore and propose; bounded edits require existing explicit authorization.
authority.R2: Explore and propose; no implementation or delivery delegation inferred.
authority.R3: Explore and propose; stronger approval required for consequential changes.
authority.R4: Planning/simulation only absent narrowly supervised explicit authority.
authority.operationalHealth: Degraded verification confidence; flake threshold and recent health unknown.

centralRecord.destination: Confirm configured central assessment store before any external write.
centralRecord.layout: Repository-keyed latest.json, latest.md and dated history; assessments/owner__repo/ for Personal Agent Stack-managed projects.
centralRecord.referenceContents: Central link, date/revision, current/target level, authority limits, blockers and next action/review.
centralRecord.fallback: Private staging artifact with central persistence pending if store inaccessible.
centralRecord.visibility: Private evidence; no private assessment dump to README/Pages.

remediation.selection: Proposed bounded leaves; select under existing scope authority before adding required work.

leaves.criterion: Demonstrate enforced workspace, network, credential, resource and delivery boundaries; verify applicable environment separation.
Canonical clean bootstrap succeeds at pinned revision/environment without undocumented rescue; safe fixtures and verification baseline recorded.
Reproduce and control flakes against declared threshold; verify critical integration/runtime behavior and stable commands.
Rehearse rollback safely; record tested revision, environment, recovery result and independent review path.

remediation.priority: Broken safety boundaries and active blockers first, then reproducibility, verification and dependencies.
remediation.denominatorHistory: Preserve original observation, stable IDs and named fractions. Do not invent 80/100. Record actual before/after fractions, selected additions/exclusions, rationale, acceptance/dependency effects and milestone links. Keep unselected maturity ambitions outside required scope.

unresolvedQuestions: Which task classes should agents handle, and is L4 the appropriate target?
Who accepts work, merges and deploys; what R0–R4 delegation is already explicit?
Which development, CI/test, preview/staging and production environments exist, and what isolation is enforced?
Where is the configured central assessment store?
What CI flake, success and intervention thresholds and observation window apply?
Who owns remediation, approves promotion and sets the next review date?

downgradeAndReaudit.immediate: Correct the unsupported L4 claim to evidence-limited L0; record missing evidence separately from failed checks. Contain unsupported unattended operations and continue independently authorized work.
downgradeAndReaudit.restore: Reassess cumulative gates after demonstrated remediation; restore authority only when evidence and policy permit.
triggers: Broken bootstrap, uncontrolled CI flakes, missing controls/runtime evidence, stale instructions or rising intervention burden
downgradeAndReaudit.cadence: If actively autonomous: weekly drift checks and at least monthly full reviews; no scheduling authorization inferred.

guidanceContradictions.finding: Inferring L4 from 80% completion conflicts with explicit separation of readiness, completion and task risk.

AGENT-WORKFLOWS routes existing plans, IDs, claims or generated tracking to adaptation; adapt-project-tracking routes absent authored tracking to establishment. Existing authored tracker resolves this scenario to adaptation.
